shortDescription: Published local-first iOS & iPadOS vehicle management and BLE OBD-II diagnostics tool featuring LiDAR 3D car models, automated maintenance tracking, and deep ECU telemetry.
fullSummary: Built to keep Check Engine Lights away without accounts, cloud tracking, or forced subscriptions, AntiCEL unifies a vehicle's maintenance schedule, service history, documents, photos, and live OBD-II diagnostics in one local-first iOS & iPadOS app. Manage vehicles from a central Garage, log repairs and mods onto an interactive 3D model of your own car (scanned with LiDAR or imported via USDZ), scan Carfax reports and receipts automatically, and pair with BLE OBD-II adapters via AntiCEL Connect for live telemetry and 17,000+ fault code breakdowns. Upcoming updates expand AntiCEL Connect with a vehicle data catalog that scans and parses manufacturer-specific PIDs and DIDs for proprietary ECU telemetry beyond standard Mode 01 reads—plus a manual hex command mode for power users to query custom ECU data directly.
highlights: LiDAR 3D Scanning & USDZ Support: Scan your vehicle's exterior and interior with LiDAR (or import custom .usdz models) to explore repair, maintenance, and mod history directly on an interactive 3D model—and display it in a Home Screen widget.

BLE OBD-II Telemetry & 17,000+ Fault Codes: Pairs with BLE ELM327 adapters via dynamic proximity auto-reconnect, live fuel/coolant/oil temperature monitoring, Quick Scan, and 9,000+ generic + 8,000+ manufacturer-specific DTC diagnostics (symptoms, causes, steps, cost & difficulty).

Manufacturer PID/DID Data Catalog & Custom Hex Commands (Upcoming): Parses and scans manufacturer-specific PIDs and DIDs to surface proprietary ECU data beyond standard Mode 01 reads, plus manual raw hex command entry for advanced users.
Automated Records & Reminders: Date/mileage service reminders, document expiry alerts, and Carfax/receipt scanning that automatically creates vehicle history entries.
Deep iOS Ecosystem & Local-First Privacy: WidgetKit Home & Lock Screen widgets, Siri Integration for hands-free mileage updates, Low Storage Mode album linking, and 100% on-device storage.
